meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 添加 iMessage 频道：从 channels 分支复制适配器到 src/channels/，追加注册导入、安装 chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1，构建并跑注册测试，再按本地（macOS）或 Photon 远程模式写配置并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词，或要求把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 频道
say.note: 会从 channels 分支复制并注册适配器

say.text: iMessage 用本地模式，读这台 Mac 的 chat.db
say.note: 接着会提示你授予完全磁盘访问

say.text: iMessage 用 Photon 远程模式
say.note: 会向你要 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API key

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1, builds and runs the registration test, then writes local (macOS) or Photon remote config and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", or when you ask to wire iMessage into NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add the iMessage channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter from the channels branch

say_en.text: Use iMessage local mode, reading this Mac's chat.db
say_en.note: Then it prompts for Full Disk Access

say_en.text: Use iMessage remote mode via Photon
say_en.note: It asks for your Photon server URL and API key
